title: Feature Suppression and Differential Privacy for Residential Traffic Classification: A Two-Home Federated Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.23521v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residential traffic classification supports service management, but learning across homes must account for heterogeneous traffic and privacy constraints. Privacy-aware training may impose uneven costs across traffic categories. We study this tradeoff in simulated two-client federated learning using 1.62 million preprocessed gateway-collected flows across six categories. We compare a full-feature baseline, feature suppression (FS), and differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) under one fixed record-level privacy setting. FS-mild excludes four timing features from 16 model inputs; it provides no formal privacy guarantee. With size-proportional aggregation, FS-mild achieves higher combined macro-F1 and worst-group F1 (the minimum per-class F1 across homes) than DP-SGD in all five seeds at both model capacities under stratified and temporal splits. The tested DP-SGD configuration incurs pronounced minority-category losses,

translated_title: 特征抑制与差分隐私在住宅流量分类中的应用：双家庭联邦学习研究
translated_abstract: 住宅流量分类支持服务管理，但跨家庭的学习必须考虑异构流量与隐私约束。隐私感知训练可能在不同流量类别间造成不均衡的代价。我们在模拟的双客户端联邦学习中研究这一权衡，使用了涵盖六个类别的162万条经预处理的网关采集流量。我们在固定的记录级隐私设置下比较了全特征基线、特征抑制（FS）与差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）。轻度特征抑制（FS-mild）从16个模型输入中剔除了四个时序特征；它不提供正式的隐私保证。在按规模成比例聚合下，在分层切分与时间切分两种数据划分、两种模型容量以及全部五个随机种子中，FS-mild均取得了比DP-SGD更高的宏F1与最差组F1（即各家庭中每类F1的最小值）的组合表现。所测试的DP-SGD配置造成了显著的少数类别损失，
tldr: 该研究在双家庭联邦学习模拟中发现，轻度特征抑制虽无正式隐私保证，却在宏F1与最差组F1上全面优于提供隐私保证的DP-SGD，且所测试的DP-SGD配置对少数流量类别造成显著性能损失。
en_tdlr: In a simulated two-home federated learning study, mild feature suppression—despite offering no formal privacy guarantee—consistently outperformed DP-SGD in combined macro-F1 and worst-group F1 across all seeds, while the tested DP-SGD configuration incurred pronounced minority-category losses.
